answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with a bonded reputation ledger: every identity locks a stake that is slashed on fraud, and trust accrues only from completed, peer-attested jobs recorded in a public atlas of work history. A fresh identity starts at its nadir, able to take only tiny jobs, like a boat tied to a jetty before it earns open water. Spawning a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand stakes and a thousand slow climbs, while one honest identity compounds trust cheaply.
